data_kind: synthetic shared event grammar; source groups are not cameras, reviewers, or independent safety labels
split_before_generation: shuffle distinct synthetic source IDs per seed, partition IDs, then draw each source profile and cases

stochastic_generator.background_visits: uniform integer 0..3, scenario-dependent, common visits only
stochastic_generator.pairing: same stochastic prefix and suffix; replacement preserves full-session unigram and bigram multisets but changes trigrams

selection: trigram Witten-Bell or Modified Kneser-Ney, epsilon 1e-8 or 1e-4, minimum dev cross entropy, lexicographic tie-break; freeze before calibration and test
calibration: 80 normal source maxima over common, rare-valid, and matched-normal sessions; conformal p=(1+# calibration scores >= test score)/(80+1); alpha=0.05

scores.tail: max token -log q, q=(1+sum_y c(h,y) I[P(y|h)<=P(x|h)])/(1+c(h)); q is a score transform, not a conformal p-value
scores.tail_missing_context: deterministic raw-count trigram to bigram to unigram backoff; record token coverage by count order
scores.cross_entropy: mean token negative log likelihood including EOS
scores.pairfrequency: add-one empirical bigram conditional negative log likelihood mean
scores.allowed_pairs: count disallowed adjacent symbol transitions, including boundaries and legal adjacent visits

test_once: 80 fresh groups; each has common, rare-valid, paired-normal, one hard replacement, and one known-nohelmet rule case; score each clean case once after saved selection/calibration/test claim
primary_estimate: paired hard-replacement source recall difference tail minus cross entropy at alpha=0.05; percentile bootstrap 5000 resamples of source groups
secondary: normal source alarms, rare-valid case alarms, top-40 and top-80 novelty review budgets across four scores
known_nohelmet: separate deterministic rule queue, never counted as novelty-positive
noise_diagnostic: drop, duplicate, flip U/W, and fragment each test sequence; reuse unchanged clean calibration; no false-alarm guarantee under shift
claim_limit: synthetic grammar demonstration only; no measured CCTV accuracy, K3 safety performance, or source independence
